intro: One phone, one case, both of you. You’ll open it with a drink at Fat Head’s in Middleburg Heights, then follow it to a few nearby places. Most stops are short walks from the car.

facts.label: Start
facts.value: Fat Head’s Brewery, Middleburg Heights — around 3 p.m.

facts.label: Length
facts.value: About 2½–3 hours, plus any breaks you take

facts.label: Walking
facts.value: Short. No single walk from the car is more than about a quarter mile.

facts.label: Driving
facts.value: A few short drives, all close to Berea

facts.label: Cost
facts.value: Nothing beyond your own drinks. Parking is free.

bring: The phone this game is installed on, fully charged
Warm layers and shoes for short outdoor walks
Nothing to write with. The game keeps track of everything.
daylight: Some steps are outdoors and are easiest in daylight. In January or early February, start no later than 3 p.m. If light, ice or a closure gets in the way, every clue has a “Can’t access this clue” option, so you can always finish.
rules: Hints never cost anything, and nothing is timed. Pause whenever you like; progress saves on its own.
Never use the game while driving. Each chapter tells you where to go before you leave.
The people and the crime are fiction. The places and their history are real. No business or park is part of the game, so you’ll never need to ask staff for anything.
install: Open this page in Safari on the iPhone you’ll use.
Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Open the game from the new icon.
In the installed app, tap Download for offline play and wait for “Ready offline.”
Optional: switch to airplane mode and reopen the app to check that it works offline. Don’t open the case until you’re together at the start.
contextNote: Safari and the Home Screen app keep separate progress. Use the Home Screen app for everything.
